tdw_board_failed_generic: An error occurred while publishing this post

tdw_board_reschedule_body: It will be published again on {{date}}.

tdw_media_bulk_hint: Move, download or delete them together from the bar above.

tdw_media_details_hint: Select a file to see its details, where it’s used and its alt text.
tdw_media_empty_folder_body: Drop files here, paste an image, or drag media onto this folder from elsewhere in the library.
tdw_media_empty_library_body: Upload images and videos, or drop them anywhere on this page. Images up to 30 MB, videos up to 1 GB.
tdw_media_image_too_large: Images can be up to 30 MB
tdw_media_no_results_body: Try another name, or clear the search.
tdw_media_not_used: No post uses this file yet.
tdw_media_type_not_allowed: This file type is not supported

tdw_pp_preview_note: An approximation. The network decides the final layout, and text past its limit is highlighted.
tdw_pp_unavailable_body: It may have been deleted, or the link is incomplete. Ask whoever shared it for a new link.
tdw_pp_error_body: This is on our side, not yours. Try again in a moment.
tdw_no_comments_body: Select some text in the post to comment on it, or add a general comment.
tdw_pp_preview_unavailable: The {{network}} preview couldn't be drawn. The post above is what will be published.
tdw_ag_placeholder: Ask the agent to draft, schedule or review posts…
tdw_ag_composer_note: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line. The agent asks before it schedules anything.
tdw_ag_mcp_note: You can also use the agent as an MCP server: Settings → Public API.
tdw_ag_off_step1: Add an OpenAI API key to the backend environment as
tdw_ag_off_step2: Restart the backend so it picks the key up.

tdw_ag_channels_help: The agent posts only to the channels you tick. They go with every message you send.
tdw_ag_hero_sub_phone: Tap Channels at the top to select the channels I should use, then ask me to draft, schedule or review posts. I can schedule to several channels at once and generate images and videos.
tdw_ag_no_channels: No channels yet. Connect one from the calendar and it shows up here.
tdw_ag_off_placeholder: The agent can't reply until AI is configured
tdw_ag_s1: Write a post announcing our new feature. Keep it under 150 words, end with a question, and schedule it for Tuesday at 10:00.
tdw_ag_s2: Plan a week of posts about our product launch: one post every weekday at 9:00, each with a different angle. Save them as drafts.
tdw_ag_s3: Write the same post in English and in Arabic (Egyptian business tone) about hiring for our team.
tdw_ag_s4: What is scheduled for next week? List the posts by day and channel.
tdw_ag_hero_sub: Select the channels I should use from the Channels panel on the left, then ask me to draft, schedule or review posts. I can schedule to several channels at once and generate images and videos. Your past chats are on the right.
tdw_no_agent_chats_body: Start a new chat and it will be kept here.
tdw_an_open_post: Open the post on the network
tdw_an_sub_channel: The network's numbers and what you published.
tdw_an_sub_all: Everything you published from Tadween, across channels.
tdw_an_no_channels_body: Connect a channel and publish from Tadween, and your numbers will show here.
tdw_an_no_network_analytics: It doesn't share numbers with apps like Tadween. You still see everything you published from here.
tdw_an_reconnect_body: The network signed Tadween out. Reconnect once and its analytics come back; your posts below are unaffected.
tdw_an_setup_body: This channel still needs a step in the calendar before it can post or report.
tdw_an_disabled_body: Enable it from the calendar to load its analytics again.
tdw_an_error_body: The network didn't answer. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, reconnect the channel.
tdw_refresh_channel_body: Reconnect it once and its numbers will start showing here.
tdw_an_no_posts_body: Posts you publish from Tadween show up here with a link to the live post.
tdw_an_rp_future: No numbers for days that haven’t happened yet
tdw_an_rp_network_limit: {{name}} shares only its last {{days}} days of analytics.
tdw_an_totals_today_only: {{metrics}}: the network only gives one total up to today, so they show when the range ends today.
tdw_an_posts_error_body: The counts below may be missing until it loads.
tdw_api_reachable_note: The assistant connects from its own servers, so {{url}} must be reachable from the internet over HTTPS. It works on your live server, not on localhost.
tdw_api_tip_401: "Invalid API Key" or 401: the key was rotated or pasted with a space. Copy it again from this page.
tdw_api_tip_restart: The tools don’t show up: restart the app or reload its MCP servers after saving the config.
tdw_api_tip_workspace: Wrong channels: the key belongs to the workspace that is open now. Switch workspace to copy another workspace’s key.
tdw_api_tip_signin: The sign-in window says the app is unknown or closes: remove the connector and add it again, then approve it while you are signed in to {{name}}.
tdw_api_tip_revoke: To disconnect an assistant that signed in, revoke it under Approved apps.

tdw_api_claude_s4: In a chat, open the Search and tools menu and make sure {{name}} is on.

tdw_api_desktop_s3: Add the server (keep any servers already in mcpServers) and save:

tdw_api_cursor_s3: Back in Settings → MCP, {{name}} turns green with its tools listed.

tdw_api_vscode_s2: Paste this and save. The key is not written in the file: VS Code asks for it once and keeps it in its secret storage.
tdw_api_vscode_s3: Click Start above the server and paste your API key when asked:

tdw_api_vscode_o1: Add this to .vscode/mcp.json (or your user configuration) and save:

tdw_api_windsurf_s1: In Windsurf open Settings → Cascade → MCP servers and choose View raw config. It opens this file:
tdw_api_windsurf_s3: Click Refresh in the MCP servers panel. {{name}} shows its tools.
tdw_api_n8n_summary: AI agent tool or a node

tdw_api_make_w2: In {{name}} open Settings → Webhooks, add a webhook with that URL and pick the channels.
tdw_api_make_w3: Each time a post is published, {{name}} sends the post to the URL. Use Send test to see the fields.
tdw_api_cli_s1: Install the CLI (needs Node.js 18 or newer):

tdw_api_need_key_body: Only workspace admins can see it. Ask an admin, or pick a sign-in option.
tdw_api_gallery_desc: Pick the app you use. Each guide has the exact settings for this workspace, ready to copy.
tdw_api_hero_title: Use {{name}} from your AI assistant and your own tools
tdw_api_hero_body: Ask Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to write and schedule posts for you, or automate {{name}} with the API, the CLI, n8n, Make and Zapier.
tdw_api_mcp_url_desc: For apps that send your API key as a Bearer header.
tdw_api_oauth_url_desc: For Claude, ChatGPT and apps that sign in with OAuth. No key needed.
tdw_api_rotate_failed: Couldn’t rotate the key. Try again.
tdw_api_rotated: New key created. The old one no longer works.
tdw_api_admins_only: Only workspace admins can see the API key.
tdw_api_admins_only_body: You can still connect Claude, ChatGPT and other apps that sign in with OAuth.
tdw_api_key_desc: Full access to this workspace: its channels, posts and media. Keep it secret, like a password.
tdw_api_rotate_hint: Leaked or shared by mistake? Rotate it: a new key replaces this one right away.
tdw_api_rotate_desc: The current key stops working the moment you rotate. Anything that uses it has to get the new key:
tdw_api_breaks_mcp: AI assistants set up with the key: Claude Code, Claude Desktop config, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, n8n.
tdw_api_breaks_cli: The CLI, scripts and CI jobs that use POSTIZ_API_KEY.
tdw_api_breaks_auto: Make, Zapier and anything else that calls the public API.
tdw_api_breaks_ok: Apps that signed in with OAuth (Approved apps) keep working.
tdw_api_public_desc: Schedule posts, upload media and list channels from your own code.
tdw_api_auth_desc: Send the key as it is in the Authorization header, with no "Bearer" (the MCP server is the one that takes Bearer).
tdw_api_limits_desc: Creating posts is limited to a number of requests per workspace each hour, set by your server. Reading is not limited. A 429 answer means wait and try again.
tdw_api_wizard_hint: Not sure what to send for a channel? Build the post in the editor and copy the request it makes.
tdw_api_build_app: Building an app for other people?
tdw_api_build_app_desc: Create an OAuth app. People approve it with their own account and you get a pos_ token that works with the API, MCP and CLI like a key.
are_you_sure_revoke_access: Are you sure you want to revoke access for {{name}}?
tdw_apps_desc: Assistants and apps you signed in to with OAuth. Revoke one and it loses access right away.
tdw_apps_empty: When you connect Claude, ChatGPT or another app by signing in, it shows up here.
tdw_set_oauth_apps_desc: Build an app that other people connect with their own account.
tdw_streak_how: Your workspace’s streak grows every day it publishes a post and ends after 24 hours without one.
tdw_paywall_ai_credits: You’ve used your AI credits this month
tdw_ai_credits_badge_title: Monthly credits left plus purchased credits
tdw_ai_credits_lead: Writing, the AI agent and images use credits. Your plan’s credits renew every month; credits you buy never expire and are used after them.
tdw_buy_ai_credits_desc: A one-time payment. Purchased credits never expire and are used after your plan’s monthly credits.
tdw_credits_slow_desc: We are still adding your credits. They will appear in a minute; you can close this window.
tdw_payment_failed_bar: Your last payment failed. Update your card to keep posting.
tdw_payment_failed_bar_member: The last payment for this workspace failed. Ask an admin to update the card.
tdw_payment_failed_retry: Stripe retries the card over the next days; everything keeps working until then.
tdw_founder_price_locked: Founder price · locked while you stay subscribed
tdw_oauth_scope_read: See your channels, posts and analytics
tdw_oauth_scope_media: Upload images and videos to your media library
tdw_oauth_sent_back_to_app: You’ll be sent back to {{client}} on this device
tdw_oauth_sign_in_hint: New to {{brand}}? You can create an account on the next screen.
tdw_oauth_revoke_hint: You can remove access any time in
tdw_oauth_err_missing_body: The app that sent you here left out part of the request. Go back to the app and connect again.
tdw_oauth_err_client_body: Its connection may have expired or been removed. Go back to the app and connect again.
tdw_oauth_err_redirect_title: This app’s return address doesn’t match
tdw_oauth_err_redirect_body: For your safety, we only send you back to the address the app registered. Remove the connector in the app and add it again.
tdw_oauth_err_pkce_title: This sign-in request isn’t secure enough
tdw_oauth_err_pkce_body: The app has to use PKCE (S256) to connect. Update the app or contact its developer.
tdw_oauth_err_action_body: Nothing was shared. Check your connection and try again.
tdw_oauth_sh_intro: {{app}} will work with your own instance. This server relays its requests, and your API key is stored encrypted.
tdw_oauth_sh_key_hint: You can also paste the MCP URL from Settings > Developers in the instance URL, it includes the key.
tdw_oauth_sh_email_hint: {{app}} uses it to identify your account.
tdw_oauth_sh_https: Your instance has to be reachable from the internet over https.
tdw_oauth_sh_too_many: Too many attempts. Try again later.
tdw_oauth_sh_failed: Could not connect to your instance.
tdw_ref_share_text_trial: I plan and schedule my social posts with Tadween. Start a {{days}}-day free trial with my link and get {{n}} AI credits when you subscribe:
tdw_ref_share_text: I plan and schedule my social posts with Tadween. Sign up with my link and get {{n}} AI credits when you subscribe:
tdw_ref_card_sub_trial: Your audience gets a {{days}}-day trial and {{n}} AI credits on their first payment.
tdw_ref_card_sub: Friends who join with your link get {{n}} AI credits on their first payment.
tdw_ref_reward_credits_badge: +{{n}} AI credits and the Ambassador badge
tdw_ref_reward_next_plan: The next plan up, free for 12 months
tdw_ref_ladder_done: You reached the top of the ladder. Thank you!
tdw_ref_none_body: Share your link. Everyone who signs up with it shows here.
tdw_ref_claim_done: Thanks! Your inviter will get the credit.
tdw_ref_claim_sub: Add their code by {{date}}. You both get rewarded once you subscribe.
tdw_ref_off_body: The referral program isn’t switched on for this workspace yet.
tdw_ref_open_partners: You’re a Tadween partner: open your partner dashboard
tdw_ref_invited_bonus_done: Your {{n}} bonus credits are in your balance.
tdw_ref_invited_bonus_wait: You get your bonus credits with your first payment.
tdw_ref_how_2: Your friend signs up and subscribes. They get {{n}} AI credits on their first payment.
tdw_ref_how_3: They count on your ladder after their second payment (or 30 days into a yearly plan). Rewards are added automatically.
tdw_ref_rules: Rewards come only from paid subscriptions, never from trials. Inviting yourself or your own workspaces doesn’t count, and refunds or chargebacks cancel rewards. Up to 10 credit rewards a month. Each workspace has one inviter, and it never changes.
tdw_invite_earn_desc: Invite friends: they get AI credits, you climb the rewards ladder.
tdw_admin_add_affiliate_desc: The user’s own workspace becomes an affiliate: commission on paid invoices instead of the rewards ladder, and a longer trial for their audience.
tdw_admin_commission_rate_hint: Optional, 1–90. Blank uses the tier rate: 30%, 35% from 10 paying customers, 40% from 30.
tdw_admin_kind_referrer_desc: Referrer: the Invite & earn rewards ladder
tdw_admin_ambassador_desc: The badge on Invite & earn. Given automatically at 5 qualified referrals.
tdw_admin_manual_rewards_desc: Applied by hand in Stripe: a 100% coupon for 12 months on the next plan, or moving the subscription to the founder price. Mark each one applied once it’s done.
tdw_admin_partners_desc: Every workspace’s referral code. Referrers climb the Invite & earn ladder; affiliates earn commission on paid invoices. Open one to change its program or apply rewards.
tdw_admin_search_partners: Code, workspace id or user id
tdw_admin_no_partners: No partners yet. A workspace gets a code the first time it opens Invite & earn.
tdw_admin_reason_same_billing: Same billing account as the partner
tdw_admin_reject_referral_desc: It stops counting for {{code}}: its pending and available rewards and commission are voided. This can’t be undone.
tdw_admin_reject_reason_ph: e.g. the partner’s own second workspace
tdw_admin_flagged_body: This workspace signed up from the same IP address or browser as a member of the partner’s workspace. It could be a colleague, or a self-referral.
tdw_admin_referrals_desc: Workspaces that joined with a partner’s link or code. Flags mark a sign-up from the same IP or browser as the partner’s members; review them and reject self-referrals.
tdw_admin_search_referrals: Partner code, workspace id or partner id
tdw_admin_mark_paid_desc: To {{code}} ({{workspace}}). Every available commission of this affiliate is settled in this payout.
tdw_admin_payout_reference_hint: The Wise transfer id, or the Payoneer / bank reference.
tdw_admin_payouts_desc: Affiliate commission paid out: cash once a month for affiliates who asked for it, Tadween balance automatically for everyone else.
tdw_admin_payout_runbook: export, pay each line in Wise, paste the Wise transfer id as reference and mark paid.
tdw_admin_due_desc: Affiliates who chose cash with at least {{min}} available. “Ready” means W-8BEN, country, payout details (and Mawthooq in Saudi Arabia) are on file. Total {{total}}.
tdw_partners_details_wise: Your Wise email or account number
tdw_partners_details_bank: IBAN, SWIFT/BIC and the account holder’s name
tdw_partners_payout_desc: Commission becomes available {{days}} days after each payment. Take it as Tadween balance, applied automatically and worth {{x}}×, or as cash once a month from {{min}}.
tdw_partners_pref_balance_desc: Every $1 of commission becomes ${{x}} off your own Tadween invoices, added automatically.
tdw_partners_pref_cash_desc: Wise, Payoneer or bank transfer around the 15th of each month, from {{min}} available.
tdw_partners_country_hint: Two letters, e.g. EG, SA, AE
tdw_partners_details_saved: Saved: {{masked}}. Leave blank to keep it.
tdw_partners_details_hint: Stored encrypted. Only the Tadween team sees it, when paying you.
tdw_partners_mawthooq_hint: Paid promotion by creators in Saudi Arabia needs a Mawthooq licence. Cash payouts there need its number.
tdw_partners_w8ben: I’m not a US person and I confirm the details of the
tdw_partners_w8ben_desc: Needed before any cash payout. We may ask for the signed form.
tdw_partners_kit_logo_body: The Tadween logo in light and dark, and app screenshots in English and Arabic.
tdw_partners_kit_video_body: A vertical screen recording: write a post, pick the time, done.
tdw_partners_kit_posts: Ready posts for LinkedIn / X / TikTok
tdw_partners_kit_posts_body: Posts and scripts you can adapt, in English and Arabic.
tdw_partners_kit_desc: Ask us for the kit: reply to your welcome email or contact support.
tdw_partners_rule_ad: Every paid or sponsored post starts with «إعلان» / “Ad”.
tdw_partners_rule_brand: No ads on the Tadween brand name (تدوين), and no coupon or deal sites.
tdw_partners_rule_self: No self-referral: your own workspaces, cards or billing accounts don’t count.
tdw_partners_rule_paid: Commission only on paid invoices, for {{months}} months from each customer’s first payment, held {{days}} days. Refunds and chargebacks take it back.
tdw_partners_rule_mawthooq: Creators in Saudi Arabia need a Mawthooq licence for cash payouts.
tdw_partners_rule_w8ben: Confirm the W-8BEN before your first cash payout.
tdw_partners_invite_only_body: It’s for creators we work with. You can still invite friends and earn rewards with your own link.
tdw_partners_sub: You earn {{rate}}% of every paid invoice from the customers you bring, for their first {{months}} months.
tdw_partners_suspended_body: New customers don’t earn commission until it’s reactivated. Contact support.
tdw_partners_tier_fixed: A rate agreed with the Tadween team.
tdw_partners_history_empty_body: Commission shows here once it’s paid, as cash or Tadween balance.
tdw_partners_pref_balance_short: $1 of commission = ${{x}} off your Tadween invoices, applied automatically.
tdw_partners_pref_cash_short: Wise, Payoneer or bank transfer around the 15th, from {{min}} available.
tdw_partners_pref_hold: Commission becomes available {{days}} days after each payment.
tdw_admin_referrals_total_hint: Workspaces that joined with a code
tdw_admin_referrals_flagged_hint: Shared IP or browser; review them

tdw_payment_method_desc: Update your card, billing address and tax details in the secure billing portal.
tdw_plan_step_title_trial: Pick your plan to keep going after your free trial
tdw_youre_on_keep_trial: Your free trial continues. Stripe charges your card when it ends, on {{date}}.
tdw_trial_ended_meanwhile: Your free trial has ended. Enter your card again to subscribe.
tdw_fb_check_trial_end: Your plan starts when your trial ends

tdw_fb_lead_left: {{n}} days left in your free trial. Schedule posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads and YouTube from one calendar.
tdw_fb_lead_left_one: 1 day left in your free trial. Schedule posts to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads and YouTube from one calendar.
tdw_continue_keep_note: If you close this, the channel stays in your list with an alert, so you can finish setting it up later. Reconnect removes it and signs you in again.
tdw_continue_error_body: The network did not answer, or the connection needs to be renewed. Try again, or reconnect if it keeps happening.
tdw_continue_all_connected_body: Each option on this account is already one of your channels. Reconnect to sign in with a different account.
tdw_continue_facebook_empty_body: We couldn't find a Page you manage, or Tadween wasn't given access to it. Reconnect and select all your Pages and businesses when Facebook asks.
tdw_continue_instagram_empty_body: Instagram professional accounts connect through a Facebook Page. Link your account to a Page, then reconnect and select that Page when Facebook asks.
tdw_continue_instagram_help: Link Instagram to a Facebook Page

tdw_continue_gmb_empty_body: Verify your business in Google Business Profile, then reconnect with the Google account that manages it.
